title: Orbitol: Crystal Generation on Wyckoff Orbits
abstract: arXiv:2610.30086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models propose crystalline materials by learning composition and geometry, but unconditional sampling gives no direct control over the space group, which constrains whether responses such as piezoelectricity are symmetry-allowed. We present Orbitol, a crystal generator built on the Crystalite diffusion Transformer that replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens. Given a space group and a collection of occupied Wyckoff positions, Orbitol generates the atom type and free coordinates of each orbit together with a compatible lattice, so every valid structure is invariant under the operations of the requested group. It generates structures two to three orders of magnitude faster than the symmetry-aware baselines at the evaluated settings. translated_abstract: 生成模型通过学习组分和几何结构来提出晶体材料，但无条件采样无法直接控制空间群，这限制了诸如压电性等响应是否在对称性上被允许。我们提出了Orbitol，一个构建于Crystalite扩散Transformer之上的晶体生成器，它用Wyckoff轨道标记取代了原子标记。给定一个空间群和一组被占据的Wyckoff位置，Orbitol生成每个轨道的原子类型和自由坐标，以及与之兼容的晶格，因此每个有效结构在所请求空间群的对称操作下都保持不变。在所评估的设置下，其生成速度比对称性感知的基线方法快两到三个数量级。在MP-20数据集上，Orbitol有13.8%的尝试产生了稳定或亚稳、独特且新颖的结构，并在弛豫后保持了所请求的空间群，而次优方法SGFM仅为10.8%。
tldr: Orbitol通过用Wyckoff轨道标记替代原子标记，实现了对空间群对称性的直接控制，能生成保持所要求空间群的稳定新颖晶体结构，且生成速度比现有对称性感知基线快两到三个数量级。
en_tdlr: Orbitol replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens to enable direct control over space group symmetry, generating stable and novel crystals that retain the requested space group two to three orders of magnitude faster than symmetry-aware baselines.
